desc: This fully adjustable Tactical Vest helps keep your shooting gear organized for easy access, so that your shooting gear is right where you need it when you out in the field. The Heavy Duty Front Zipper and 2 adjustable Quick Fastener Buckles makes it easy for you to get into the vest and for secure fit. Three adjustable side straps on each side ensure a secure custom fit to your body and the length is adjustable via the Triple Shoulders Hook and Loop panels. The back panel also includes a Heavy Duty Rescue Drag Handle and Loop patch for Name Tapes and Moral Patches.
